name: Blackberry Farm
insider_take: This legendary Relais & Châteaux property in the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains is where Southern hospitality meets world-class luxury on a working farm estate.
whats_special: Blackberry Farm spans 4,200 acres of pristine Tennessee wilderness and operates as a genuine working farm with heritage livestock, organic gardens, and an award-winning brewery. The property features just 69 rooms and suites, ensuring an intimate experience. Their culinary program is James Beard Award-winning, showcasing hyper-local ingredients from their own farm and foothills foraging.
pro_tip: Book the Master Distiller experience to create your own personalized whiskey blend in their on-site distillery, then take home a bottle with your custom label as the ultimate souvenir.
dont_miss: The sunrise horseback ride through mountain meadows, followed by a farm-to-table breakfast prepared by their award-winning culinary team. Also explore the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, just minutes away, which offers some of the most biodiverse hiking trails in America with over 1,500 species of flowering plants.
pros: World-class farm-to-table dining with Michelin-starred cuisine
Luxurious mountain resort setting in Great Smoky Mountains foothills
Extensive outdoor activities including fishing, hiking, and horseback riding
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
cons: Remote Tennessee location requires travel planning
